title: Polka Dot Bows & Floral Blouse
prompt: A close-up portrait of an original young woman with soft, wavy light brown hair parted in the center, styled into two loose braids tied with red polka-dot bows at the sides, with a few loose wisps framing her face. She wears small gold hoop earrings and a delicate thin silver chain necklace over a white crew-neck tee with a small printed label. Over the tee, a cream pinafore-style top with a small red floral print, a ruffled trim, and puff sleeves. She has a gentle, closed-mouth smile and a soft, dewy complexion with light freckles. Soft, even studio lighting against a pale, neutral backdrop. A palette of cream, cherry red, and soft brown with light floral accents. Sweet, nostalgic, and wholesome, in the style of a vintage-inspired children's or heritage clothing catalog.
workingNotes:
- The red polka-dot bows are the signature detail; name the color and pattern.
- "Closed-mouth smile" keeps the expression soft; change to "neutral" for a more serious tone.
